protocol.protocol: Singer-separated decoder follow-up; vocadito previously inspected for model comparisons, not a blind generalization test. Development only selected bridge_seconds=0 and share_gaps=false. No model training. Both annotators reported separately.
protocol.selection_reason: Best development macro onset and offset F1 for both annotators among 0, 20, 40 ms bridging; freeze before held-out labels.

scope: Decoder-only comparison using cached CREPE contours. Singer split frozen before this follow-up; vocadito had already been inspected for prior model comparisons. Not a blind benchmark or percentage of correct notes.
decision: Keep the classic stable default. Offer rest-preserving decoding as an experimental comparison, because GTSinger regresses despite vocadito improvements.
